glosses: slavish; obeying or sticking to a rule without reflection

examples.text: Sklavische Einhaltung von Regeln bewirkt oft genug das Gegenteil dessen, was mit diesen Regeln eigentlich beabsichtigt war.
examples.translation: Slavish observation of rules quite often achieves the opposite of what these rules were originally intended to.
examples.english: Slavish observation of rules quite often achieves the opposite of what these rules were originally intended to.

glosses: adj. adv. 奴隶般的，盲从的
